notes.title: Thanks for playing 10.000 Pizzas Please during Automation Fest!
notes.notes: [h3]Thank you for the love during Automation Fest![/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3798960/10000_Pizzas_Please/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]We were blown away by how many of you jumped into the pizza factory, spun your conveyor belts, and unleashed absolute kitchen chaos. 🔥🍕[/p][p][/p][p]Your support means a lot to our team  every comment and wishlist makes a difference.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve been listening closely to your feedback, and we’ll be improving the demo for Next Fest based on your suggestions. notes.title: Fresh Update: Speed, Clarity, and Better Rails!
notes.notes: [p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3833250/10000_Pizzas_Please_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Hey cheeselord, [/p][p]We've just rolled out a juicy new update with quality of life improvements based on your feedback. Here's what's cooking:[/p][list][*][p][b]Speed Controls Added:[/b][/p][p]You can now play at 1x, 1.5x, or 2x speed. Get through levels faster or take your time planning the perfect slice![/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Task Bar:[/b][/p][p]We've polished the task bar to better show your current objectives and which pizza needs to be delivered at the end of each one.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rail System Improvements:[/b][/p][p]Rails are now smoother and more reliable.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Edit Mode Direction Indicators:[/b][/p][p]When in edit mode, machines and rails now show their direction clearly. This makes it easier to spot misaligned rails and fix delivery issues.[/p][/*][*][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks to everyone who's been playing the demo and sharing feedback! Your support helps us bake a better game every day.[/p][p]Stay cheesy,[/p][p]The Dev Team 🍕[/p]
